title: Giving up piano and how it helped his arranging
summary: He stopped playing piano until Kansas City and says piano skill made arranging easy.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: It was one of them, yes. I wouldn't play much more on the piano. I just kind of switched. I didn't play piano any more until I got to Kansas City. Just before I joined Basie, there was no trumpet jobs open so I played piano in a little honky tonk place called The Florida Blossom.
Well how well could you play?
Yes. Sometimes I'm sorry now I didn't keep it up, but I was a very, very good pianist.
But this of course, was to be useful to you.
Oh yes, in arranging, yes. You know the keyboard, and it's very easy to arrange if you are a good pianist/guitar player, if you know chords.
